value.rationale: A sharp natural maximum number of simultaneously stable full-planar boundary equilibria in a mathematically and game-theoretically motivated invariant-square quartic family. The construction realizes the maximum robustly among twelve distinct hyperbolic boundary equilibria. This is distinct from an unmotivated special-parameter calculation or a basic unconstrained circle alternation bound, which alone would permit six.
